paragraphs.text: Tolsimir Wolfblood was a long-lived elven evangelist of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica and the leader of the Ledev Guardians . He was killed by Yarus while defending Trostani during the Ravnican crime wave of c. 10,080 ZC .

Tolsimir was a great warrior and a skilled archer who wore green and silver armor. His mount was a massive white wolf named Voja Fenstalker , the father of Biracazir . He was more dedicated to his guild than even his own life, which would come to an end during the events of Murders at Karlov Manor .
First seen during the Decamillennial , they were still active during the War of the Spark , where they fought to oppose the forces of the Dreadhorde .

After the New Phyrexian Invasion , Tolsimir was still present. He was one of the attendees at the Orzhov celebrations at Karlov Manor. Here he became a person of interest after a string of murders. The detective Alquist Proft ruled him out as a suspect but still invited him to a gathering at Vitu-Ghazi , where he revealed that the party responsible for the murders was a member of the Conclave. Tolsimir stepped forward and tried to admit guilt, but Proft said that he was trying to take the fall for another member of his guild, which he had determined to be the guildmaster Trostani herself. When the dryad Oba revealed herself as the mastermind and began attacking all the guild members present, Tolsimir defended her, allowing himself to be fatally impaled with a broken rafter by Yarus .
